messages:
laura_finance: Reseller flagged duplicate tier pricing on Azure Marketplace invoice — they were charged both 'starter' and 'startup' rates for same seats. invoice shows 220 seats split across two SKUs.

miguel_revenue: ouch. do we have invoice + reseller id?

laura_finance: invoice INV-2026-07-09-chan-44, reseller channel-maple, sub res-44. billing snapshot 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z. invoice total $6,160 (220 seats at mixed rates).

emma_ops: paste the SKU mapping export? need to see which seats mapped to which SKU.

laura_finance: mapping (redacted):
2026-07-01T00:00:00Z,res-44,seat_range:1-150,sku:starter
2026-07-01T00:00:00Z,res-44,seat_range:1-200,sku:startup

laura_finance: looks like overlapping ranges caused both SKUs to be applied.

billing-bot: Created ticket TCK-5320: "Azure reseller SKU overlap causing double billing - channel-maple" assigned to eng-ops.

miguel_revenue: finance, we should hold payment and provisionally credit the overlap amount. Quick calc: overlapping seats = 150 (starter) billed twice? assume 150 * ($28 startup - $18 starter) = $1,500 adjustment estimate. Finance ok to provision up to $2k?

laura_finance: finance approves provisional credit up to $2k pending root cause. AP hold payment and prepare credit memo template.

emma_ops: I'll patch mapping validation to detect overlapping seat_range and reject connector pushes. Also will add a nightly check to alert when multiple SKUs apply to same seat ids.

miguel_revenue: pinging partner-ops to confirm they didn't intentionally migrate SKUs.

laura_finance: noted. will attach final credit to TCK-5320 after eng verifies corrected mapping and we recalc exact delta. ETA EOD Mon. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

miguel_revenue: thanks team :thumbsup:
